title: College Requirements Matrix
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Compare application requirements across every college on your list, spot the one-of-a-kind requirements before they're missed, and total the workload.

learningObjectives: Students will compare application requirements across colleges and organize them to identify which requirements are shared and which are unique to one college.

controls: Add college, Edit selected, Remove selected, and Load Emily's list buttons
Row editor with dropdowns and inputs for each requirement

keyQuestions: Why might a requirement appear only on a college's own website and not on its Common App page?
How can you write fewer, better supplemental essays across a long list?
Why do teacher letters rarely multiply your work even when ten colleges ask for them?
commonMisconceptions: Every college on the Common App asks for the same things.
Ten colleges means asking ten sets of teachers for letters.
assessmentOpportunities: Students build a matrix for their own list and name every unique requirement and its deadline.
